candidates.change_summary: Removed the protection by deleting the require(!locked_) check so Put can be reentered while locked_; keeps setting/clearing locked_ to true/false.
Inverted the require to require(locked_) so the modifier allows execution only when already locked, changing when Put can be called.
Move clearing of locked_ to before the function body so locked_ is reset before executing the function, altering reentrancy protection timing.
Set acc.unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime unconditionally (remove max with block.timestamp), allowing future unlock times in the past and changing stored state after Put.
Do not update acc.balance (delete the balance addition), so Put changes only unlockTime and log, altering the observable post-call balance.
Update the wrong account's balance by using tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so state under the caller address differs after Put.
Replace the external call to msg.sender.call{value: _am}("") with a transfer using payable(msg.sender).transfer(_am) so failure behavior and gas semantics differ.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier invocation from Collect so reentrancy behavior (and thus observable balance changes after Collect) can differ.
Change the nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ = false before the call body, inverting lock timing so reentrancy protection is broken and may change Collect's observable effect.
